name: sdg03
title: SDG 3: Good health and well-being (SDG Atlas of Bolivia 2026)
description: The SDG 3 (Good health and well-being) index of the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026 (SDSN Bolivia) and the 7 indicators behind it, for Bolivia's 343 municipalities and indigenous autonomies (GAIOC), at two points in time: near the 2012 census and near the 2024 census, stored as 2012 and 2024 so that their change can be studied.

sources.title: Andersen, L. E., & Argandoña, F. (2026). Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026: Brechas y tendencias del desarrollo sostenible en las Entidades Territoriales Autónomas, 2012–2024. La Paz: Universidad Privada Boliviana, SDSN Bolivia.
sources.geo:creator: Lykke E. Andersen and Fabiana Argandoña (SDSN Bolivia, Universidad Privada Boliviana)

geo:citation: GeoDevelopment Observatory of Bolivia (2026). SDG 3: Good health and well-being, from the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026 (343 municipalities, ~2012 and ~2024). https://github.com/quarcs-lab/geo4bolivia/blob/main/docs/datasets/sdg03.md
geo:notes: Both periods are stored at nominal years: 2012 for the Atlas's initial values (~2012) and 2024 for its final values (~2024). Each indicator's actual reference years differ (e.g. 2008 and 2023 for the health survey, three-year averages for volatile indicators) and are given in its description and in `geo:reference_years`.
Load one variable in both periods, e.g. `geo.load("sdg03", variables="index_sdg3")`, and its change with `df.pivot(index="geo_id", columns="year", values="index_sdg3")`.

The units are the 343 municipalities and indigenous autonomies (GAIOC) of 2025. Four of them were created after the 2012 census (TIOC-Raqaypampa, San Pedro de Macha, TIOC-Jatun Ayllu Yura and TIOC-Territorio Indígena Multiétnico); the Atlas gives them values in both periods.

The indicators are rates, shares, ratios or indices, so their aggregation rule is `none`. Population-weighted averages can use the census population of the `sdg` dataset: `geo.aggregate(df, to="department", rules={"index_sdg3": "weighted_mean:population"}, weights=geo.load("sdg", variables="population"))`.

resources.name: sdg03-municipality
resources.geo:source_geometry: Municipal statistics of the Atlas, linked by INE municipality code

fields.name: geo_id
fields.title: Municipality ID
fields.description: GDO-Bolivia municipality geo ID (BO-DD-PP-MM) of the 343-unit municipality map (SDSN Bolivia 2025: municipalities and indigenous autonomies), numbered as in GADM 4.1 plus four units created since; its boundary is in geo/boundaries/. It nests by prefix into the department (BO-DD) and province (BO-DD-PP) IDs; department and province numbers follow GADM order and differ from INE codes.

fields.name: year
fields.title: Period
fields.description: Period of the values in the row: 2012 holds the Atlas's initial values (near the 2012 census) and 2024 its final values (near the 2024 census). Each variable's actual reference years are given in its description and in geo:reference_years.

fields.name: mun_id
fields.title: INE municipality code
fields.description: Official municipality code of the National Statistics Institute (INE), DDPPMM (department, province, municipality) stored as an integer without the leading zero (e.g. 20101 = Nuestra Señora de La Paz), as in the Atlas. The Atlas's rows are linked to geo_id through this code.

fields.name: index_sdg3
fields.title: Good health and well-being index (0-100)
fields.description: SDG 3 (Good health and well-being) index of the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026, on a 0-100 scale where 100 means the goal's targets are met and 0 the worst situation. Following the global SDG Index of SDSN, each of its 7 indicators is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between a worst and a best value (given in each indicator's description), with the direction set so that higher is always better and values beyond the bounds capped; the index is the simple mean of the available rescaled indicators. Components: Births attended by skilled health personnel (%); Infant mortality (per 1,000 live births); Under-5 mortality (per 1,000 live births); HIV incidence (per million people); Tuberculosis incidence (per 100,000 people); Vector-borne disease index (0-1); Mean parity of adolescent women 15-19 (children per woman). Initial value (~2012) stored at 2012 and final value (~2024) at 2024; its components refer to different years around each census. Atlas: “Índice ODS3”.
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg3_1_cpp
fields.title: Births attended by skilled health personnel (%)
fields.description: Percentage of women aged 15-49 who gave birth in the last five years whose last birth was attended by a doctor, nurse or nursing assistant; for 2012, births in a health facility are taken as attended by skilled personnel. Source: own calculation of the Atlas from the INE Population and Housing Censuses of 2012 and 2024. Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 3 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0 (worst, 0) and 100 (best, 100), higher is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 90 and major challenges from 70 on. Atlas indicator 03_01_02_01_cpp, “Porcentaje de partos atendidos por personal de salud calificado” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg3_2_tmi
fields.title: Infant mortality (per 1,000 live births)
fields.description: Infant mortality rate (deaths before age 1 per 1,000 live births): the department's rate from the EDSA survey, distributed across its municipalities by each municipality's share of the department's deaths under 1 relative to its share of children under 1 in the census mortality section. Source: INE, EDSA 2008 and 2023, weighted with the mortality section of the 2012 and 2024 censuses. Initial value 2008 (stored at 2012) and final value 2023 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 3 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 39.7 (worst, 0) and 1.1 (best, 100), lower is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 12 and major challenges from 20 on. Atlas indicator 03_02_01_02_tmi, “Tasa de mortalidad infantil (<1 año, por 1,000 nacidos vivos)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg3_2_tmn
fields.title: Under-5 mortality (per 1,000 live births)
fields.description: Under-five mortality rate (deaths before age 5 per 1,000 live births): the department's rate from the EDSA survey, distributed across its municipalities by each municipality's share of the department's deaths under 5 relative to its share of children under 1 in the census mortality section. Source: INE, EDSA 2008 and 2023, weighted with the mortality section of the 2012 and 2024 censuses. Initial value 2008 (stored at 2012) and final value 2023 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 3 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 130.1 (worst, 0) and 2.6 (best, 100), lower is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 25 and major challenges from 50 on. Atlas indicator 03_02_01_03_tmn, “Tasa de mortalidad en la niñez (<5 años, por 1,000 nacidos vivos)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg3_3_vih
fields.title: HIV incidence (per million people)
fields.description: Average annual number of notified HIV cases per 1,000,000 inhabitants over three years. Source: case notifications of the Ministry of Health and Sports. Initial value average 2011–2013 (stored at 2012) and final value average 2022–2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 3 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 721.5 (worst, 0) and 0 (best, 100), lower is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 15 and major challenges from 155 on. Atlas indicator 03_03_01_04_vih, “Incidencia de VIH (por 1,000,000 habitantes)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg3_3_tub
fields.title: Tuberculosis incidence (per 100,000 people)
fields.description: Average annual number of notified tuberculosis cases per 100,000 inhabitants over three years. Source: case notifications of the Ministry of Health and Sports. Initial value average 2011–2013 (stored at 2012) and final value average 2022–2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 3 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 199.2 (worst, 0) and 0 (best, 100), lower is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 10 and major challenges from 75 on. Atlas indicator 03_03_02_05_tub, “Incidencia de tuberculosis (por 100,000 habitantes)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg3_3_vec
fields.title: Vector-borne disease index (0-1)
fields.description: Mean of three min-max normalised incidences of vector-borne diseases, each averaged over three years: malaria (annual parasite index per 1,000 people), Chagas (% of dwellings infested with the vinchuca bug) and dengue (cases per 10,000 people); 0 means no incidence. Source: own calculation of the Atlas from case notifications of the Ministry of Health and Sports. Initial value average 2011–2013 (stored at 2012) and final value average 2022–2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 3 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0.68 (worst, 0) and 0 (best, 100), lower is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 0 and major challenges from 0.3 on. Atlas indicator 03_03_03_06_vec, “Índice de enfermedades transmitidas por vectores” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
fields.geo:source: Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026

fields.name: sdg3_7_tfa
fields.title: Mean parity of adolescent women 15-19 (children per woman)
fields.description: Average number of live-born children per woman aged 15-19. Source: INE tabulations of the INE Population and Housing Censuses of 2012 and 2024. Initial value 2012 (stored at 2012) and final value 2024 (stored at 2024). In the SDG 3 index it is rescaled linearly to 0-100 between 0.71 (worst, 0) and 0 (best, 100), lower is better, values beyond the bounds capped; the Atlas counts the target as met at 0.1 and major challenges from 0.5 on. Atlas indicator 03_07_02_07_tfa, “Paridez media en adolescentes (15 a 19 años)” (Andersen & Argandoña 2026).
